title: Research: 2026 LLM API pricing + AI SaaS gross margins

tasks.note: Captured real list prices from Snyk, Semgrep, Sonar, Codacy, Aikido, Socket, CodeRabbit, Greptile and Qodo straight off their own pricing pages — including the billing units (contributor, seat, lines of code, credits, org-level) and what flips each vendor to contact-sales. Effect: the deck can now anchor Bug Ledger's price against a verified $18–$50 per-dev/month band instead of a guess.

Added 6 new layers (accessibility, claims-accuracy, privacy/legal, testing, SEO, observability): 41 detectors (was 14), 31 seeded catalog entries, 8 optimisers, plus site labels/colours — deployed and verified live
Cloudflare Workers AI Neuron unit (/bin/zsh.011/1k neurons) + Llama per-MTok equivalents captured
Cheap-tier priced: DeepSeek, Together, Groq, Fireworks, Cloudflare Workers AI — gives the deck a 100x+ cost spread between frontier and commodity routing tiers

Got vendor-published per-1M-token prices across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Together, Groq, Fireworks and Cloudflare — and the key finding: a ~65x output-cost spread between frontier and commodity models, plus prompt caching (-90%) stacking with batch (-50%) to cut the input leg ~20x. Effect: proves the scan COGS is an architecture choice we control, which is exactly the margin question investors press on.

Built the COGS stack investors actually audit: hosting (verified Cloudflare unit prices), LLM inference, support headcount and Stripe at 2.9% + 30c. Benchmarks captured: SaaS COGS 15-30% of revenue = 70-85% gross margin, cloud infra typically 6-15% of revenue. Effect: the deck can show a defensible cost-per-customer line and explain why a Cloudflare-native, zero-egress architecture beats the benchmark.

Assembling the tables, the sources list and the monetization recommendation, and running the actual arithmetic: what a customer costs to serve on Cloudflare vs what the same scan costs if we pay for the inference vs if the customer's own agent does. Effect: the deck gets a defensible gross-margin number instead of an assertion.
